plainText:
Shinya Fukumatsu (Japanese: ふくまつ進紗 Fukumatsu Shinya) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Fukumatsu was born on November 30, 1958, in what was once , . He started work on the with as character of the day Dr. Ferrara, before gaining his first notable role during as 's butler Hobbes. Fukumatsu is currently affiliated with .
